# Congmiao FeedBot

> AI/LLM entry point for a Rust Telegram multi-platform feed parser.

Congmiao FeedBot accepts links from X, YouTube, Pixiv, Bilibili, and NetEase Cloud Music, normalizes upstream data, processes media, and sends Telegram messages. The project uses Rust 2024, Tokio, Teloxide, Reqwest, SQLx/SQLite, FFmpeg, ffprobe, and yt-dlp.

## Essential Context

- [AI project context](docs/AI_CONTEXT.md): architecture, request flow, modules, invariants, development, testing, deployment, operations, and release.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): rules coding agents must follow when modifying this repository.
- [README](README.md): authoritative user guide, configuration, commands, deployment, troubleshooting, and release instructions.
- [Environment template](.env.example): supported environment variables and defaults.
